topic: metrics and reporting for an early-stage open-source project

subtopics.scope: Metric-to-decision mapping: choosing metrics that each drive a concrete decision instead of vanity reporting in early-stage open-source projects.

metrics drive decisions lean startup project health

subtopics.scope: Public project-health metrics derivable from existing repo artifacts: blocker counts, CI lane pass/fail per architecture, ADR cadence, dependency pin staleness.

architecture decision records cadence tracking ADR process

subtopics.scope: Honest flagging of not-yet-measurable metrics: adoption, community trust, telemetry-by-design constraints, download and pull counts.

open source adoption metrics limitations privacy no telemetry

subtopics.scope: Business-health metrics tied to an offer catalog: readiness-gate-to-offer ratio, paid-pilot count and outcome, SLA adherence, funding secured versus targeted.

subtopics.scope: Reporting cadence and ownership at single-founder scale: weekly informal checks versus event-driven review, no invented owner roles.

subtopics.scope: Threshold-setting discipline and out-of-scope boundaries: recording that a metric matters versus picking target numbers, no dashboards before data exists.
